mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, company_id, checkup_date, hospital_name, checkup_type, summary, report_file_url, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_health_checkup WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT hc.id, hc.user_id, u.name AS user_name, hc.company_id, c.name AS company_name, hc.checkup_date, hc.hospital_name, hc.checkup_type, hc.summary, hc.report_file_url, hc.uploaded_by, hc.uploaded_at, hc.created_at FROM tb_health_checkup hc LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = hc.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = hc.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE hc.id = #{id} AND hc.deleted = 0

SELECT hc.id, hc.user_id, u.name AS user_name, hc.company_id, c.name AS company_name, hc.checkup_date, hc.hospital_name, hc.checkup_type, hc.summary, hc.report_file_url, hc.created_at FROM tb_health_checkup hc LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = hc.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = hc.company_id AND c.deleted = 0
ORDER BY hc.checkup_date DESC, hc.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_health_checkup ( user_id, company_id, checkup_date, hospital_name, checkup_type, summary, report_file_url, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{companyId}, #{checkupDate}, #{hospitalName}, #{checkupType}, #{summary}, #{reportFileUrl}, #{uploadedBy}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_health_checkup SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
